title: Leaves Vietnam
description: Larry's Vietnam service ended around September 1965, roughly a year after it began. His departure date and route home have not yet been established from records.
researchNotes: The DD-214 shows he did not come straight home: his last duty assignment was an Army medical command in Japan (USARJ), and his foreign service ran until separation at Oakland on November 30, 1965. A departure from Vietnam around September 1965 followed by two-plus months in Japan fits both his recollection and the form. The exact Vietnam departure date should be in the NPRC personnel file.
